releases.notes:
# Eleetra v1.0.2 for Minecraft 1.21.3

## Updates & Compatibility
- Updated for Minecraft 1.21.3 compatibility
- Updated Fabric Loader to 0.16.8
- Updated Fabric API to 0.108.0+1.21.3

## Technical Changes
- Updated boat entity handling for 1.21.3 compatibility
- Changed elytra flight detection method to use new API
- Fixed entity spawning mechanics
- Updated mixin injection points for new version
- Improved physics-based boost calculations

## Features Reminder
- Shift + Right-click to use entire stack of rockets at once
- Real-time HUD showing:
  - Current and max speeds
  - Maximum acceleration
  - G-forces experienced
  - Distance traveled
  - Current coordinates
  - Cardinal direction

## Installation
1. Install Fabric Loader 0.16.8 or later for Minecraft 1.21.3
2. Install Fabric API 0.108.0+1.21.3
3. Place mod JAR in your mods folder

## Notes
- Server installation required for rocket boost mechanics
- Client installation needed for HUD features
- Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.3 only

## Known Issues
None currently reported. Please submit issues on GitHub if you encounter any problems.
